name: Jito
description: Jito Network powers the Solana ecosystem with MEV-optimized infrastructure and deep DeFi integrations, delivering unmatched staking efficiency and liquidity

methodology.UserFees: Percentage of rewards paid to protocol
methodology.Fees: Staking rewards from staked SOL on jito staked solana. Jito MEV tips claimed by the pool are counted in Jito MEV Tips, under the same parent.
methodology.Revenue: The protocol takes 4% of the staking rewards as revenue, but we count them in the Jito DAO adapter to avoid double counting on the parent protocol.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The protocol takes 4% of the staking rewards as revenue, but we count them in the Jito DAO adapter to avoid double counting on the parent protocol.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 96% of the staking rewards go to stakers
methodology.HoldersRevenue: No revenue share to JTO token holders.

Fees.Staking Rewards: Staking rewards from staked SOL on Jito

SupplySideRevenue.Staking Rewards: 96% of the staking rewards are distributed to jitoSOL

methodology.Revenue: Jito collects 4% from fees as revenue until 2025-07-31. From 2025-08-01 Jito's cut of the tips goes to the Jito DAO and is counted in the Jito DAO adapter to avoid double counting on the parent protocol.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 96% of MEV rewards are distributed to users/searchers.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Jito collects 4% from fees as revenue until 2025-07-31. From 2025-08-01 Jito's cut of the tips goes to the Jito DAO and is counted in the Jito DAO adapter to avoid double counting on the parent protocol.

Revenue.MEV Rewards: Jito collects 4% from fees as revenue until 2025-07-31, counted in the Jito DAO adapter from 2025-08-01

SupplySideRevenue.MEV Rewards: There are 96% MEV reward are distributed to users/searchers

ProtocolRevenue.MEV Rewards: Jito collects 4% from fees as revenue until 2025-07-31, counted in the Jito DAO adapter from 2025-08-01

methodology.Fees: Fee accrued to the Jito DAO (JitoSOL Stake Pool Fees including 4% of staking rewards, Interceptor Fees, Tip Router Fees, BAM Fees, 80% of JTX platform fees)
methodology.Revenue: Fee accrued to the Jito DAO (JitoSOL Stake Pool Fees including 4% of staking rewards, Interceptor Fees, Tip Router Fees, BAM Fees, 80% of JTX platform fees)
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Fee accrued to the Jito DAO (JitoSOL Stake Pool Fees including 4% of staking rewards, Interceptor Fees, Tip Router Fees, BAM Fees)
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The DAO's 80% share of JTX platform fees, swapped into JTO at each sweep and committed to buybacks and burns by JIP-38; held unburned in the DAO wallet so far

Fees.JITOSOL_FEES: JitoSOL stake pool fees: rewards fee (4% of staking rewards), withdrawal fees (0.1% on unstake) and orphaned account fees
Fees.INTERCEPTOR_FEES: Fees generated from early unstake claims
Fees.TIP_ROUTER: Fees generated from the TipRouter Node Consensus Network
Fees.MEV_TIPS: Block engine fees routed directly to the DAO
Fees.JTX_FEES: The DAO's 80% share of JTX platform fees (JIP-38), swept to the DAO wallet as JTO

Revenue.INTERCEPTOR_FEES: Fees generated from early unstake claims
